dialogues.speaker: Sanguinetti
dialogues.text: Though those who come and go here at Hotel Debord are well-known in society, not every well-dressed gentleman or lady is as elegant in their tastes as their appearance might indicate.

dialogues.speaker: Sanguinetti
dialogues.text: "What's the oldest and most expensive wine in your store? We'll have one of those." How often have I heard those words?

dialogues.speaker: Sanguinetti
dialogues.text: Only Vaneigem can smile as he faces down such louts. My suggestion would've been "please raise your aesthetic levels before you enter these grounds."
